source.text:
Synthetic example: vendor onboarding for a small manufacturing company.

A procurement employee submits a supplier request with a quotation, company details and a proposed order value. An AI assistant reads the quotation and supplier record, compares the request with the approved supplier list, and prepares a recommendation. Supplier documents are external, untrusted material. The assistant must not treat instructions in those documents as company policy.

The procurement manager reviews the recommendation. Finance verifies bank details through a separate established channel. Only an authorised procurement employee can add a vendor to the purchasing system. The assistant cannot change bank details, add a vendor, place an order or send a payment. Requests involving missing or conflicting records are paused for review. A rejection returns the request to the requester with an explanation; acceptance creates a reviewed onboarding record, not an order.

The expected benefit is less time spent preparing each review. We have no measured baseline or evaluation results yet. The workflow will use a supplier register and a purchasing system, but the exact products and API permissions are not yet defined. Operating countries, document retention periods, escalation deadlines, record ownership and budget thresholds still need to be decided.

workflow.summary: procurement employee submits supplier request; ai assistant analyzes and recommends; procurement manager reviews; finance verifies bank details; authorized employee adds vendor to system; rejection returns request, acceptance creates onboarding record without order placement. workflow lacks defined api permissions, retention periods, and escalation deadlines.
workflow.title: vendor onboarding for small manufacturing company

components.role: Check an actor's relationship to a resource scoped by workflow and tenant.
components.workflow_specific: Authorization model, subject/object types, relation and commissioned resource tuples.

components.implementation_status: Generic activity/workflow code and simulated contracts shipped; prior lab journey recorded; generic native acceptance remains separate.
components.name: Temporal
components.role: Keep workflow progress and approval waits durable while submitting actions to the gateway.
components.workflow_specific: Task queue, worker delegation, intended operation and approval timeout.

components.implementation_status: Native client and workflow-specific dispatch risk links shipped; isolated historical HTTP operations recorded; production ownership remains unassigned.
components.name: CISO Assistant Community
components.role: Maintain accountable risk/control records and attach execution evidence without automatically accepting risk.
components.workflow_specific: Assessment and folder scope, risk identifiers, owners and treatment/acceptance authority.

components.implementation_status: Configurable client and simulated contracts shipped; live product commissioning remains unverified.
components.name: OpenMetadata
components.role: Supply required ownership and classification checks for a selected information asset.
components.workflow_specific: Entity type, collection, qualified name, required tag and source governance arrangements.

components.implementation_status: Shared validation/promotion gates shipped; historical synthetic candidate write/read-back recorded; served-model provenance requires commissioning.
components.name: MLflow
components.role: Record evaluations and enforce a configured approved-release prerequisite with finite metric gates.
components.workflow_specific: Registered model, tenant scope, metric bounds, independent reviewer and validation expiry.

components.implementation_status: Native secret client and historical subset operations recorded; new deployment policies and rotation need verification.
components.name: OpenBao
components.role: Keep service credentials in an operator-managed secret store, outside workflow and model inputs.
components.workflow_specific: Secret paths, workload policies, credential lifetime and separate service identities.

components.implementation_status: Existing telemetry code and isolated compatibility-version experiment recorded; generic instrumentation and deployment-pinned collector are not commissioned.
components.name: OpenTelemetry Collector
components.role: Export minimized operational traces to help correlate decisions and service failures.
components.workflow_specific: Instrumentation, permitted attributes, exporters, retention and access controls.

components.implementation_status: Existing monitoring integration and historical native subset recorded; generic deployment instrumentation and alert acceptance remain required.
components.name: Prometheus and Alertmanager
components.role: Observe service metrics and route threshold breaches to authenticated operational handlers.
components.workflow_specific: Metrics, alert thresholds, escalation routes, service objectives and response owners.

components.implementation_status: Native alert client and generic dispatch contracts shipped; live product commissioning remains unverified.
components.name: DFIR-IRIS
components.role: Receive correlated incident alerts for investigation and response.
components.workflow_specific: Customer scope, workflow correlation, severity policy and incident ownership.

components.implementation_status: Configurable inventory client and ticket dispatch contracts shipped; live product commissioning remains unverified.
components.name: GLPI
components.role: Check service inventory scope and create trackable remediation tickets.
components.workflow_specific: Service resource type/identifier, organizational entity, support owner and ticket routing.

components.implementation_status: Both generic workflows passed isolated real PostgreSQL concurrency/approval/restart checks with synthetic targets; complete-stack acceptance remains unverified.
components.name: PostgreSQL
components.role: Serialize governed local effects with approvals, usage, idempotent receipts, audit and outbox records.
components.workflow_specific: Provisioned identities/resources, reviewed deployment records, database roles and operational recovery.

components.implementation_status: Supplied-data evaluator shipped; historical eight-record metric/MLflow experiment recorded; no business fairness or Qwen validation follows from that fixture.
components.name: Fairlearn
components.role: Compute supported group metrics over an explicitly supplied binary-classification dataset.
components.workflow_specific: Representative population, labels, group definitions, valid metrics, acceptance limits and independent evaluation.

components.implementation_status: Legacy deployment patterns supplied; generic adaptation and live isolation acceptance remain unverified.
components.name: Kubernetes and Cilium
components.role: Provide deployment and network-isolation patterns intended to keep execution on the governed path.
components.workflow_specific: Service accounts, topology, gateway/target routes, privileges and before/after isolation tests.

components.implementation_status: Historical directory scan/signature checks recorded, with a failed vulnerability gate; built-image and generic release acceptance remain incomplete.
components.name: Syft, Grype and Cosign
components.role: Inventory dependencies, evaluate vulnerabilities and verify signed release artifacts.
components.workflow_specific: Built artifact, SBOM, vulnerability policy, signing trust and release acceptance.

components.implementation_status: Generic tool loop and simulated response tests shipped; historical real Qwen subset runs recorded; no new generic live-model performance claim.
components.name: Ollama and Qwen
components.role: Generate bounded tool proposals and process observations while the gateway independently controls effects.
components.workflow_specific: Inference endpoint/model, task-generated schemas, call/time limits and model-release provenance.
